issues: 工作台按源码第一个数字猜成 112f，f112 后 48f 的真静止被截掉，镜头停在刹车那一帧
调试占位标题 "OSCILLOSCOPE STREAM V2"；平灰底上白卡 2px 灰边，监控画面没有“活着”的氛围
尖峰只在经过写入点时读数变色，流走后就是一段普通曲线，事件没有留下痕迹
曲线左端被硬切，余辉是灰色模糊粗线；刹车起点初速 10.8px/f 高于流速 8，有一下顿挫
changes: 补导出 OSCILLOSCOPE_STREAM_V2_DURATION = 160（112f 流动+刹停 + 48f 真静止）
改暗场监控语境：带色相深色柔光背景 + 颗粒，深色卡面发丝线 + 内高光 + 深投影；去掉调试标题、卡片居中放大，加 LIVE 呼吸灯（刹停后熄灭）
曲线下淡靛面积渐变，左 22% 旧数据遮罩渐隐出画；写入端是由暗到亮渐变的磷光余辉 + 带光圈的写入点
尖峰段整段染琥珀并随流带走，峰顶垂下虚线到底部事件道，钉一枚 “Burst · 2,232 req/s” 标签；读数颜色按尖峰包络平滑过渡
刹车距离改为 SPEED×12/3，out-cubic 初速与流速相等，减速无跳变
issuesEn: The workbench guessed 112f from the first number in the source, cutting off the 48f hold so the shot ended mid-brake
Debug title "OSCILLOSCOPE STREAM V2" and a white card with a 2px grey border on flat grey; no sense of a live system
The burst only recoloured the readout as it passed the write head; once it scrolled away it was an ordinary bump with no trace
The left end of the line was hard-cut, the afterglow was a thick grey blur, and the brake started at 10.8px/f vs the 8px/f stream, causing a hitch
changesEn: Dark monitoring look: tinted dark soft-light backdrop with grain, dark card with hairline, inner highlight and deep shadow; debug title removed, card centred and enlarged, a breathing LIVE pill that goes dark at the freeze
Faint indigo area fill under the curve, old data masked to fade out over the left 22%, a dim-to-bright phosphor tail and a haloed write head
The burst segment stays amber as it scrolls, with a dashed drop line from the peak to a bottom event lane holding a "Burst · 2,232 req/s" tag; readout colour follows the burst envelope smoothly
Brake distance set to SPEED×12/3 so the out-cubic starts at exactly the stream speed, no velocity jump
